description: This file defines a JSON schema for the DTV API, including data structures, methods, and event definitions relevant to DVB services and tuner management.

methods.name: addLnb
methods.description: Add a new LNB to the database.

methods.name: addSatellite
methods.description: Add a new satellite to the database.

methods.name: startServiceSearch
methods.description: Starts a service search, with events for progress and updates.

methods.name: finishServiceSearch
methods.description: Finishes a service search, optionally saving the found services.

methods.name: startPlaying
methods.description: Starts playing the specified DVB service, returning a play handle.

methods.name: stopPlaying
methods.description: Stops playing the service associated with a given play handle.
